contract_assessment.architecture: RA-044 section 3 permits none from a verified source rule using applicable manufacturer evidence. Cross-market engine equivalence, ESS alone and missing hybrid words are not sufficient.
contract_assessment.implementation: _supports accepts explicit none/nonhybrid/non hybrid raw claims. ESS and Without E-Torque both fail as raw support for none. It cannot evaluate the proposed multi-document hardware inference.
contract_assessment.consequence: A future fully scoped hardware rule needs separate implementation compatibility review. No synthetic nonhybrid source claim was inserted, and no code or contract was changed.
